in_marathi.name: Utsavraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Festival of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Utsavraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Utsavraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'utsava' meaning 'festival' and 'raj' meaning 'king'. This name is given to a boy to signify that he is the king of festivals and celebrations. In Hindu mythology, Utsavraj is often associated with Lord Shiva, who is considered the lord of festivals and celebrations.
